original_log1p.zero_handling: original pipeline: zero counts kept; CPM -> log1p (log1p(0)=0) -> per-sample centring (CLR)

multiplicative_replacement_0p65.zero_handling: multiplicative replacement: zero raw value -> 0.65 x gene-wise nonzero minimum (pre-CPM, cohort-native units); genes with no nonzero value kept at zero and recorded; then CLR

measured_only_158.zero_handling: measured-only restriction: the 70 structurally unmeasured (all-zero in IMvigor210) genes excluded; CLR unchanged ( gene_measured_only verbatim)

artifact_presence.question: Is 'the 70 unmeasured genes become CLR library-size proxies and dominate the anchored PC1 loading (88.7%)' robust to zero handling?
artifact_presence.mechanism_note: multiplicative replacement CANNOT substitute values for the 70 genes (no nonzero minimum exists in IMvigor210), so they remain all-zero and remain CLR library-size proxies: the artifact is driven by STRUCTURAL non-measurement, not by the sporadic-zero treatment choice

artifact_removal_restores_transport.question: Does removing the artifact (or altering zero handling) restore external transport (AUC CI excludes 0.5 beneficially in both external cohorts)?
